peoples_entry.name: The Eternal State
peoples_entry.note: Deco-Gothic + Qing bureaucratic paper state ruled from the Sanctum by metallic-skinned True Heirs over human ministries, porcelain cuirassiers, Valley Quarantine wardens, Hayrant Yeti-Watch soldiers, Farport customs guards, and Canal/Kiln/Farside guilds (25 canon tiers at 100% M/F parity; strict zero-red and zero-sun-ray law; tools/garments/cultures/eternian.py).
